mapper.select: SELECT process_snapshot.id AS snapshotId, process_snapshot.active_order_id AS activeOrderId, process_snapshot.work_order_id AS workOrderId, work_order.code AS workOrderCode, route.name AS routeName, process_snapshot.route_process_id AS routeProcessId, process_snapshot.process_id AS processId, process.code AS processCode, process.name AS processName, process_snapshot.planned_quantity_snapshot AS requiredQuantity, allocation.event_id AS eventId, allocation.allocated_quantity AS submittedQuantity, COALESCE(submitter.nickname, submitter_profile.display_name) AS submitterName, reviewer.nickname AS reviewerName, pool_event.server_submit_time AS submittedAt FROM mes_pro_process_pool_active_order_process_snapshot process_snapshot INNER JOIN mes_pro_process_pool_active_order active_order ON active_order.id = process_snapshot.active_order_id AND active_order.tenant_id = process_snapshot.tenant_id AND active_order.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN mes_pro_work_order work_order ON work_order.id = process_snapshot.work_order_id AND work_order.tenant_id = process_snapshot.tenant_id AND work_order.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN mes_pro_route route ON route.id = process_snapshot.route_id AND route.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN mes_pro_process process ON process.id = process_snapshot.process_id AND process.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_pro_process_pool_report_allocation allocation ON allocation.active_order_id = process_snapshot.active_order_id AND allocation.route_process_id = process_snapshot.route_process_id AND allocation.process_id = process_snapshot.process_id AND allocation.tenant_id = process_snapshot.tenant_id AND allocation.lifecycle_status = 'CURRENT' AND allocation.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_pro_process_pool_event pool_event ON pool_event.id = allocation.event_id AND pool_event.tenant_id = allocation.tenant_id AND pool_event.event_type = 'PRODUCTION_SUBMIT' AND pool_event.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_users submitter ON submitter.id = pool_event.actual_employee_id AND submitter.tenant_id = pool_event.tenant_id AND submitter.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_pro_process_pool_team_employee_profile submitter_profile ON submitter_profile.id = pool_event.actual_employee_id AND submitter_profile.tenant_id = pool_event.tenant_id AND submitter_profile.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, event_id, leader_user_id FROM ( SELECT review_log.tenant_id, review_log.event_id, review_log.leader_user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY review_log.tenant_id, review_log.event_id ORDER BY review_log.reviewed_at DESC, review_log.id DESC ) AS review_rank FROM mes_pro_process_pool_submission_review review_log WHERE review_log.deleted = 0 ) ranked_review WHERE review_rank = 1 ) latest_review ON latest_review.event_id = pool_event.id AND latest_review.tenant_id = pool_event.tenant_id LEFT JOIN system_users reviewer ON reviewer.id = latest_review.leader_user_id AND reviewer.tenant_id = pool_event.tenant_id AND reviewer.deleted = 0 WHERE process_snapshot.active_order_id = #{activeOrderId} AND process_snapshot.deleted = 0 ORDER BY process_snapshot.id ASC, pool_event.server_submit_time ASC, allocation.id ASC
